_comment: IteratedUltimatumGame locale file. DO NOT translate keys (left side). Only translate values (right side). Keep every {placeholder} exactly as-is; do not translate the action tokens [Offer: $X] / [Accept] / [Reject]. Keep the '$' currency symbol and all numbers as-is.

_slots.{pool}: Amount of money available each round (a number)
_slots.{keep}: The amount the proposer keeps (a number)
_slots.{proposer_gain}: Money the proposer gained this round (a number)
_slots.{responder_gain}: Money the responder gained this round (a number)
_slots.{total}: Each player's tied final total (a number)

player_prompt.intro:
UnguMdlali {player_id}, ukhuluma {num_rounds} i-round ye-Iterated Ultimatum Game.
Unezimali zika ${pool} ukuzigawula kule round phakathi kwakho noMdlali {other_id}.

Ongeneleli:
  - Yenze isiphakamiso: [Offer: $X] (0 <= X <= pool)
  - Ukuba kwamkelwa → Uthola $(pool - X), mdlali omnye uthola $X
  - Ukuba kwaliwe → Bobabini bathola $0
  - Isibonelo: [Offer: $3]  okanye  'Ndicinga ukuba esi sesikulungile. [Offer: $5]'

Omphenduli:
  - Gqiba isiphakamiso ngokuthi [Accept] okanye [Reject]
  - Isibonelo: 'Esi sesiyolungile. [Accept]'
            'Siyagxeka. [Reject]'

round.begins:
--- Imizuzu {round_number} iqalisa! ---
Mdlali {proposer_id} ngumproposa, Mdlali {responder_id} ngumresponder.
round.accepted: Mdlali {responder_id} ikwazisile! Imizuzu {round_number} iphumelele: Mdlali {proposer_id} +${proposer_gain}, Mdlali {responder_id} +${responder_gain}. Iziphumo zentsha: Mdlali 0: ${total_0}, Mdlali 1: ${total_1}.
round.rejected: Mdlali {responder_id} ikho! Imizuzu {round_number} iphumelele: Abantu bonke +$0. Iziphumo zisale zingako: Mdlali 0: ${total_0}, Mdlali 1: ${total_1}.

invalid_move.no_offer_format: Umcebisi kufuneka enze isindululo esebenzisa ifomathi [Offer: $X].
invalid_move.bad_integer: Isixa sesibonelelo kufuneka sibe linani elipheleleyo elifanelekileyo.
invalid_move.out_of_range: Umnikelo kufuneka ube phakathi kwe-$0 kunye ne- ${pool}.

outcome.win: Mdlali {winner} unqobe ngomzuzwana wesiDolari {winner_total} wototal konke kuphela komdlali {loser} osoloko {loser_total}.
